note: Fixes data loss in saved files. A launch lug's or rail button's mounting angle was never read and every save overwrote it with 180 degrees; an off-axis inner tube's radial position was written but never read, so a desktop split cluster collapsed onto the centreline and saving made it permanent. Both now survive a round trip. Camera shrouds, protuberances, lugs and rail buttons also gain an editable angle around the body - so a camera can point between the fins rather than down one - honoured in all three views. Elliptical fin sets show their cant angle. No flight numbers change.
